description: Search the 5,000 most downloaded Hugging Face datasets in the daily build, returning matches in descending order of download count. Optionally filter by signal, task tag and declared licence ID; all supplied filters must match. Returns up to 50 results; licence_evidence links to the Hub file, API record or file list checked for a declared licence. Signal values: permissive = permissive or share-alike licence reported; restrictive = use restrictions reported; conflict = possible licence conflict; unclear = insufficient or unrecognised licence information. These signals do not establish permission to use a dataset. Licence facts reported by the dataset and its declared sources. Not legal advice, and not a grant of permission to use the dataset.
